ante_base_chips.note: Base chip requirement ('base') per ante. Antes <= 0 (reachable only via Hieroglyph/Petroglyph) use 100. Plasma Deck doubles every requirement (ante_scaling = 2) on top of the stake table.

endless_formula.formula: raw = A8 * (1.6 + (0.75 * c) ** (1 + 0.2 * c)) ** c, with c = ante - 8 and A8 = that stake table's ante-8 value; amount = floor(raw); then truncate to 2 significant digits: amount -= amount % 10**(floor(log10(amount)) - 1)
endless_formula.rounding: Truncation (floor) to two significant figures. The wiki says 'rounded to two significant digits' but its own table (e.g. ante 9 white: raw 115,405 -> 110,000) shows truncation.
endless_formula.overflow: From ante 39 the requirement exceeds the double-precision max (~1.8e308) and becomes nan; nan cannot be beaten, so ante 39 is effectively the end of Endless.
endless_formula.verified: Formula reproduces the wiki table exactly for antes 9-12 at all three scalings (checked by script).

Small Blind.notes: No reward money on Red Stake and above.

Boss Blind.notes: See bosses.json. Disabling The Wall / Violet Vessel (Chicot, Luchador) drops the requirement back to 2x base; a disabled Needle stays at 1x.

Showdown Blind.antes: every ante that is a multiple of 8 (8, 16, 24, 32)

required_score: required = base(ante, stake table) * blind chip_mult * deck ante_scaling (Plasma = 2, others 1). You win the blind when total round score >= required.

run_structure.ante_increase: Ante goes up by 1 each time a Boss Blind is defeated.
run_structure.endless: After beating the ante-8 Showdown Blind the run is won; the player may continue (Endless) from ante 9.
run_structure.loss: If a round's hands run out before the requirement is met the run is lost (Mr. Bones saves once if score >= 25% of requirement; no blind reward then).

interest.rule: interest = interest_amount * min(floor(money / 5), cap / 5); money measured at end of round before cash-out payouts (Gold cards, Reserved Parking etc. that pay during the round DO count; Golden Joker/Rocket etc. paid at cash-out do NOT).
interest.To the Moon: joker: +1 to interest_amount (an extra $1 per $5 held), cap on number of $5 blocks unchanged

cash_out_order: remaining hands ($1 each; Green Deck $2 + $1 per discard)
joker end-of-round money (Golden Joker, Cloud 9, Rocket, Satellite, Delayed Gratification...)
end_of_round_before_cash_out: Gold cards held in hand ($3 each, retriggerable)
money_rules.skipped_blinds_pay: Skipping a blind gives its tag but no reward money and no shop visit.

notes: Blue Stake and above: -1 discard (2 by default).
A round always starts with at least 1 hand even if modifiers would reduce it to 0.
Hand size <= 0 when a blind starts is an instant loss.
Deck modifiers in decks.json, voucher modifiers in vouchers.json.

skip_rules.reward: Each Small/Big Blind displays one random tag (rolled when the ante starts); skipping that blind grants that tag. Both can be skipped in the same ante.
skip_rules.cost: No blind reward money, no shop after a skipped blind, no hands played that round.
skip_rules.avoid_boss: Bosses can only be rerolled (Director's Cut/Retcon, $10 each, or Boss Tag) or disabled (Chicot, Luchador).
